notes: Overlay mode now shows selling volume correctly, and update notices now show up reliably.
changelog: Overlay mode now draws the red selling bars on top of the green total-volume bars, where before the green covered them
The update notice now appears once the chart goes live, instead of sometimes never showing up
Strategies using Volume Pressure Pro now always read the current bar's values, even when a line or bar series is hidden on the chart
Hot volume markers no longer appear on bars with zero volume or before the average has enough bars
When buying and selling volume are equal, both bars now stay in full colour
Charts with long history load faster when the stats labels are on
